change.scope: Additional application video-quality reductions, unicast and each group peer. Native GCC/NACK/TWCC still consumes original RTCP immediately; no network role or relay prioritization.
change.rule: Known cumulative video loss must increase and remain unrecovered for at least3 seconds, then be confirmed by a fresh report advancing the RTP sequence. A shrinking gap to baseline cancels; duplicate or old reports cannot confirm.
change.lifecycle: Unknown initial loss starts a baseline. Signed counters, sequence wrap, report expiry, backwards clocks, confirmed-route changes and video-stream recreation are covered. Confirmed event identity expires after15 seconds without healthy-report renewal.
change.compatibility: New local JSON video_persistent_loss_report_us is preferred by the app. Older native libraries retain the raw video_loss_report_us fallback. Existing raw loss metadata and all wire reports are preserved.

verification.native_policy_smoke: PASS: recorded late fill, persistent loss, duplicate/reordered reports, signed counters, sequence wrap and lifecycle
verification.native_integration: PASS: real RR parsing, unicast/group persistence, healthy peer cannot mask another loss, malformed compound cannot partially publish
verification.raw_rtcp_regression: PASS: existing RR/SR, sub-percent, stream binding, cache/compound and group expiry tests

native_replay.scope: Native cumulative-loss persistence replay on valid recorded same-peer video RR blocks; not a media performance benchmark.

pair.limitations: One capture per revision; not statistical proof of a universal speedup. Native sink sequence increments for each decoded OnFrame; counter rate is not screen presentation or sub-second stutter timing. Original strict audio gate is still recorded unchanged, but is not the optimization target per user steering.

remaining_work: One direction remains about3.8fps at320x240, versus15fps in the other. Three reductions follow new persistent-loss evidence on that source; trace the remaining genuine loss/budget interaction.
Native group source-yield policy may still floor video on a short audio impairment; qualify a full group capture.
Complete ordered/canonical interaction isolation and full route/fanout accounting.
Qualify physical speech/headset loudness, screen, mute and reconnect.

remaining_loss_summary.scope: Sequence holes at successful shim egress are not independently proof of network loss; investigate pre-send pacer discard/guarded RTP and decoder progress. Eventual ingress does not prove a timely useful frame.
